scripts.prepare: node --input-type=module -e "import { execFileSync as git } from 'node:child_process'; try { if (git('git', ['config', '--get', 'core.hooksPath'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim() === '.husky/_') git('git', ['config', '--unset', 'core.hooksPath']); } catch {}" && vp config --no-agent
scripts.format: astro sync && vp lint --fix --deny-warnings . && eslint . --fix && vp fmt --write .
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['.astro', '.nimbus', 'dist', '.cloudflare/output']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
